tasks.title: Three-Tier Memory Bank Brick, 2-Phase Continuous Cycle & <150-Line Linter
tasks.description: Core Three-Tier Memory Hierarchy (Tier 1 Global, Tier 2 Cluster Invariants, Tier 3 Domain Memory Bank) extracted from production multi-project usage with <150-line budget enforcement and 2-phase continuous session cycling.
tasks.spec: Provide 6 modular memory templates, /start and /update-memory skills, and automated line-budget linter.
acceptanceCriteria: Enforces <150 lines across all memory-bank/*.md files.
2-Phase /update-memory closes current milestone and auto-starts next session banner.

tasks.title: On-the-Fly CLI Initializer & Universal One-Line Shell Installer
tasks.description: Zero-restart CLI initializer (npx github:johnny-saigon/antigravity-memory-bank init) and curl | bash installer that auto-detects stack, git remotes, and ports.
tasks.spec: Support interactive and headless (-y --commit) initialization and plugin mode (--as-plugin).
acceptanceCriteria: Activates skills and rules in an open Antigravity IDE window with zero restart.
Auto-detects frontend, backend, database, and port from package.json and .env.

tasks.title: Consolidated Context Export & Zero-Loss Clean Deinstallation
tasks.description: Export project memory to a single consolidated markdown file and tar.gz archive, and run automatic backup before uninstalling Memory Bank files.
tasks.spec: Implement export and uninstall commands in bin/cli.mjs with ./memory-backups/ archival.
acceptanceCriteria: Generates consolidated markdown and .tar.gz archive in ./memory-backups/.
Cleanly removes memory-bank artifacts while preserving custom skills/rules.

tasks.title: Non-Destructive In-Place Upgrade Workflow for Existing Installations
tasks.description: Trickled up from upgrading BinaryDay, RemoveBackGround, and SnapCal: upgrade skills, linters, and hooks in-place while preserving 100% of custom memory-bank/*.md domain documents.
tasks.spec: Implement upgrade command in bin/cli.mjs that detects existing project title and health probes without overwriting memory-bank/*.md.
acceptanceCriteria: 100% preservation of existing memory-bank/*.md files.
Upgrades AGENTS.md, skills, and package.json lifecycle scripts.

tasks.title: Automated Historical Context Scraper (Git, Docs & Antigravity Transcripts)
tasks.description: Trickled up from downstream init runs: automatically scrape git commit history, markdown documentation, and ~/.gemini/antigravity/brain/*/transcript.jsonl logs during init.
tasks.spec: Extract recent accomplishments, completed milestones, and pending tasks from git, docs, and brain transcripts to populate initial memory-bank/*.md files.
acceptanceCriteria: Scrapes git commits, docs/*.md, and Antigravity conversation transcripts.
Populates activeContext.md and progress.md with real project history on day one.

tasks.title: Incremental Context Auto-Synchronizer, Git Post-Commit Hook & CI Workflow
tasks.description: Keep memory-bank/activeContext.md and progress.md synchronized automatically on every feat:/fix: git commit and main branch push with zero LLM token usage.
tasks.spec: Install post-commit git hook, incremental sync script, and GitHub Actions workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Automatically updates last synchronized commit hash and accomplishments on commit.
CI workflow verifies <150-line budget on every push and PR.

tasks.title: Passive Observer Invariant & Operational Board Separation into docs/
tasks.description: Trickled up from downstream project usage: codify that memory-bank/*.md is strictly a passive observer baseline (<150 lines) while operational boards live in docs/.
tasks.spec: Update agent directives and skills to prohibit active ticket management inside memory-bank/*.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Memory Bank stays <150 lines (~1.5k tokens) as a read-only context baseline.
Operational tickets and bug logs are separated into docs/.

tasks.title: Decoupled Zero-Token Backlog Engine, /backlog-start Skill & Review Pane Kanban
tasks.description: Eliminate the 15k-35k token cost of chat-based task capture via an offline zero-token backlog store (docs/backlog.json), interactive Kanban board (backlog.html), and frugal /backlog-start execution skill.
tasks.spec: Implement CRUD CLI commands, interactive dark-mode HTML Kanban board with live local HTTP save bridge, and 3-phase /backlog-start skill.
acceptanceCriteria: Zero-token offline task capture via npm run backlog or Review pane UI.
1-click /backlog-start <ID> prompt copy and automated sprint closure + work recap.

tasks.title: Automated Board & Bug Record Adapter During init / upgrade
tasks.description: Trickled up from upgrading downstream projects with pre-existing markdown boards: automatically discover and migrate MIGRATION_BOARD.md, BACKLOG.md, ROADMAP.md, and BUG_FIX_RECORDS.md into docs/backlog.json.
tasks.spec: Parse markdown task headers, checklists, and milestones into structured docs/backlog.json entries without duplicates.
acceptanceCriteria: Automatically migrates existing markdown boards and bug records on init/upgrade.
Renders synchronized docs/BACKLOG.md and backlog.html Kanban immediately.

tasks.title: Dogfooding & Strict Upstream Package Isolation Architecture
tasks.description: Dogfood the Three-Tier Memory Bank and Backlog Kanban directly inside antigravity-memory-bank while isolating downstream npx installs via package.json files whitelist and isSelfRepo guards.
tasks.spec: Add files whitelist to package.json, detect isSelfRepo in bin/cli.mjs, and git-ignore ephemeral docs/backlog.html.
acceptanceCriteria: npm pack --dry-run includes only the 29 distributable engine files.
isSelfRepo prevents self-overwriting or deleting upstream scripts/.

tasks.title: Preserve Existing Curated Notes Non-Destructively in sync-memory-context.mjs
tasks.description: Trickled up from downstream commit sync: sync-memory-context.mjs previously overwrote manually curated accomplishments in activeContext.md and progress.md.
tasks.spec: Prepend newly detected git commits above existing bullets and deduplicate by short commit hash.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing manual notes in activeContext.md and progress.md are preserved.
Commits are deduplicated by hash.

tasks.title: Bypass post-commit Hook During Git Rebase, Cherry-Pick & Merge
tasks.description: Trickled up during branch rebasing: post-commit hook triggered sync-memory-context.mjs mid-rebase, dirtying the working tree and interrupting git rebase.
tasks.spec: Check for rebase-merge, rebase-apply, MERGE_HEAD, and CHERRY_PICK_HEAD in .git/ before executing post-commit memory sync.
acceptanceCriteria: post-commit hook exits cleanly as a no-op during rebase, merge, or cherry-pick.

tasks.title: Fix Active Brain Directory Discovery & Always Render docs/backlog.html
tasks.description: Trickled up when backlog.html was not created in the active session after npm run memory:upgrade: findActiveBrainDir() relied on directory stat.mtimeMs (which does not update when transcript.jsonl is appended) and required backlog.html/task.md to already exist.
tasks.spec: Score brain directories by workspace path references inside .system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl, use transcript.jsonl mtimeMs for recency, and always write docs/backlog.html alongside <brainDir>/backlog.html.
acceptanceCriteria: Accurately targets the active conversation brain directory even in brand-new sessions.
Always writes docs/backlog.html in the project workspace.

tasks.title: Remove Downstream Project Names & Private Host IPs from Upstream Templates
tasks.description: Trickled up after upstreaming the backlog engine from a downstream repo: hardcoded SnapCal references and Vast.ai host IPs leaked into upstream templates and skills.
tasks.spec: Resolve project title dynamically from docs/backlog.json or path.basename(ROOT) and codify generic upstream template rules in rules/AGENTS.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Zero downstream project names or private host IPs in bin/, skills/, rules/, or templates/.
scripts/backlog.mjs and templates/scripts/backlog.mjs remain byte-identical.

tasks.title: Prevent MILESTONE-* Items from Being Re-Imported as Duplicate Feature Tasks
tasks.description: Discovered while dogfooding upgrade inside antigravity-memory-bank: checklistItemRegex in lib/backlog-adapter.mjs matched - [x] **MILESTONE-1** in docs/BACKLOG.md and imported it into tasks.
tasks.spec: Filter out MILESTONE-* IDs and existingMilestoneIds in sectionRegex and checklistItemRegex loops in lib/backlog-adapter.mjs.
acceptanceCriteria: Repeated upgrade runs are 100% idempotent (0 duplicate tasks imported from MILESTONE-* bullets).

tasks.title: Fix Stale _npx Cache, Workspace-Dominance Brain Matching & Sandboxed Kickoff Prompt Clipboard/Bridge
tasks.description: Resolved 3 root causes preventing 100% reliable backlog.html generation on upgrade/init and blocking Kickoff Prompt clipboard copy in sandboxed Review pane iframes: (1) npm cached stale git tarballs in ~/.npm/_npx, (2) flat +200 brain scoring caused multi-project conversations to steal backlog.html writes, and (3) unescaped double quotes in task titles + navigator.clipboard permissions blocked Kickoff Prompt.
tasks.spec: Auto-clean _npx cache on exit and in package.json scripts, use workspace-dominance scoring in findTargetBrainDirs(), pre-render cards server-side with quote-safe kickoffTask(id), and implement 4-layer synchronous execCommand('copy') + top auto-selected prompt bar + local native pbcopy bridge on 127.0.0.1:4199.
acceptanceCriteria: 100% accurate docs/backlog.html and <brainDir>/backlog.html generation across all 5 colocated projects on init and upgrade.
Kickoff Prompt works reliably on titles with quotes and copies to clipboard inside sandboxed iframes and via native OS pbcopy.

tasks.title: Automated Zero-Dependency E2E CLI Test Suite (init, upgrade, sync, export, uninstall)
tasks.description: Add an automated smoke test script using node:test and node:assert that exercises init, upgrade, sync, export, and uninstall inside an isolated temporary directory.
tasks.spec: Verify full CLI lifecycle and assert 100% preservation of custom memory-bank/*.md files across upgrade.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests init, upgrade, sync, export, and uninstall in an isolated temp directory.
Verifies custom memory-bank/*.md domain files are 100% preserved across upgrade.
Passes via npm test.

tasks.title: Automated Byte-Parity Check Between scripts/backlog.mjs and templates/scripts/backlog.mjs
tasks.description: Ensure upstream bug fixes to scripts/backlog.mjs never drift from templates/scripts/backlog.mjs distributed to downstream projects.
tasks.spec: Add a byte-identity assertion between scripts/backlog.mjs and templates/scripts/backlog.mjs during npm test.
acceptanceCriteria: npm test fails if scripts/backlog.mjs and templates/scripts/backlog.mjs diverge.

tasks.title: Automatic Context & UX/UI .zip Bundle Ingestion in /backlog-start & Backlog Engine
tasks.description: Automatically detect, copy, and unpack attached files (such as UX/UI .zip exports containing DESIGN.md, tokens.json, HTML/Tailwind screens, and mockups) via CLI, Review pane UI, or inline /backlog-start prompts.
tasks.spec: Automatically detect, copy, and unpack attached files (such as UX/UI .zip exports containing DESIGN.md, tokens.json, HTML/Tailwind screens, and mockups) via CLI, Review pane UI, or inline /backlog-start prompts.

tasks.title: Pull API Keys, Env Contracts, MCP Server Configs & Customizations into Memory Bank on Init/Upgrade/Sync
tasks.description: API keys (.env*, eas.json, credentials/*.p8, host token files), MCP server configs (~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json, .mcp.json), and Antigravity customizations (.agents/rules/*, .agents/skills/*, .agents/workflows/*, ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json, ~/.gemini/config/config.json) were not pulled into memory-bank during init, upgrade, or sync. Additionally, bin/cli.mjs ignored positional directory arguments.
tasks.spec: Create lib/customizations-scraper.mjs and embed standalone sync in scripts/sync-memory-context.mjs to generate memory-bank/integrationsAndCustomizations.md (<150 lines, masking raw secret literals while preserving key names, file paths, non-secret IDs, MCP tools, rules, skills, and hooks), wire into init/upgrade/sync in bin/cli.mjs, support positional targetDir, and redeploy across all installed instances.
acceptanceCriteria: Automatically indexes all .env* keys, eas.json credentials, host tokens, MCP servers, rules, skills, and hooks into memory-bank/integrationsAndCustomizations.md.
Never commits raw secret literals to Git while giving agents 100% visibility into key names and file paths.
bin/cli.mjs supports positional target directory and upgrades all installed repositories cleanly under <150 lines.

tasks.title: On-the-Fly Lifecycle Hooks (.agents/hooks.json), Zero-Manual-Step Memory Registration & 10-Point Mandatory Ingestion Checklist
tasks.description: Eliminate manual memory:sync / memory:upgrade actions when new API keys, MCP servers, skills, rules, repo paths, or architectural decisions are added. Enforce a 10-Point Mandatory Baseline Ingestion Checklist on every init and upgrade, auto-partition AGENTS.md @[...] includes under the 24KB per-rule cap, and wire .agents/hooks.json (SessionStart, PostToolUse, Stop) for real-time on-the-fly synchronization.
tasks.spec: Create lib/ingestion-checklist.mjs to verify all 10 baseline pillars at init/upgrade time, install .agents/hooks.json (SessionStart, PostToolUse, Stop -> scripts/sync-memory-context.mjs --quiet --hook), update AGENTS.md Mandate #3 for immediate on-the-fly registration of pertinent facts, and balance @[...] includes across AGENTS.md and .agents/rules/memory-context.md (<24KB).
acceptanceCriteria: Zero manual steps required when adding API keys, MCP servers, skills, rules, or repo paths (.agents/hooks.json auto-syncs on SessionStart, PostToolUse, and Stop).
10-Point Mandatory Baseline Ingestion Checklist runs and passes 10/10 across all installed repositories on init and upgrade.
Automatic <24KB rule shard balancer ensures 100% of memory-bank/*.md files load into Antigravity rules without truncation.
